# pangolin_site (Data Source)

Look up an existing Pangolin site by site_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_site" "example" {
  site_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `nice_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
